items.title: Metformin in 2019.
items.summary: Metformin is the first-line pharmacologic treatment for type 2 diabetes and the most commonly prescribed drug for this condition worldwide.

items.title: Diabetes Medications as Monotherapy or Metformin-Based Combination Therapy for Type 2 Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
items.summary: Systematic review and meta-analysis evaluating comparative effectiveness and safety of diabetes medications as monotherapy or metformin-based combination therapy.

items.title: Comparison of the efficacy and safety of 10 glucagon-like peptide-1 receptor agonists as add-on to metformin in patients with type 2 diabetes: a systematic review.
items.summary: Network meta-analysis comparing efficacy and safety of 10 GLP-1 receptor agonists as add-on to metformin in type 2 diabetes patients.

items.title: Comparative effectiveness of GLP-1 receptor agonists on glycaemic control, body weight, and lipid profile for type 2 diabetes: systematic review and network meta-analysis.
items.summary: Systematic review and network meta-analysis evaluating comparative efficacy of GLP-1 receptor agonists on glycemic control, body weight, and lipid profile.

items.title: 5-year follow-up of the randomised Diabetes Remission Clinical Trial (DiRECT) of continued support for weight loss maintenance in the UK: an extension study.
items.summary: 5-year follow-up of DiRECT trial showing weight management intervention resulted in 36% diabetes remission at 2 years.

items.title: 3 years of liraglutide versus placebo for type 2 diabetes risk reduction and weight management in individuals with prediabetes: a randomised, double-blind trial.
items.summary: 3-year trial of liraglutide 3.0 mg versus placebo for type 2 diabetes risk reduction in individuals with prediabetes.

items.title: Obesity and type 2 diabetes mellitus: connections in epidemiology, pathogenesis, and treatments.

items.title: Emerging therapeutic approaches for the treatment of NAFLD and type 2 diabetes mellitus.
items.summary: Review of emerging therapeutic approaches for treatment of NAFLD and type 2 diabetes mellitus.

items.title: Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus: A Review of Multi-Target Drugs.
items.summary: Review of multi-target drugs for type 2 diabetes mellitus treatment given that mono-target therapy often fails.

canonicalFacts.claim: Metformin is the first-line pharmacologic treatment for type 2 diabetes worldwide
Type 2 diabetes affects 90-95% of all diabetic patients
GLP-1 receptor agonists are effective for glycemic control and weight loss in type 2 diabetes
Weight management intervention can achieve diabetes remission in a significant proportion of patients
Young-onset type 2 diabetes has more rapid β-cell deterioration and higher complication risk

lifestyleRecommendations.recommendation: Weight management intervention for diabetes remission
Lifestyle modifications are essential as mono-target drug therapy often fails

redFlags: Gliclazide can cause acute hepatitis in rare cases
Young-onset type 2 diabetes has accelerated complications compared to type 1 diabetes
